relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: morphine (20 µM and 200 µM), LPS (1 µg/mL), and PMA (500 nM) robustly induced NETs formation

relationships.subject: Neutrophil extracellular traps
relationships.evidence_quote: morphine-induced NETs can be engulfed by macrophages through the GAS6-AXL axis, which subsequently triggers the activation of the TLR7/TLR9-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that inhibition of NLRP3, either through genetic ablation or using the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950, significantly alleviated morphine tolerance

relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that morphine administration significantly increased the levels of IL-1β, IL-6, IL-18, and TNF- a, as well as the protein level of p-p65 in the DRG

relationships.subject: AXL
relationships.evidence_quote: mice lacking Axl exhibited significantly improved morphine analgesic effects (Fig. 6D), accompanied by decreased levels of IL-1β and IL-18 in the DRG, as well as reduced expression of NLRP3, Casp-1, p-NR1, p-CREB, and p-CaMKII proteins

key_findings: Morphine-induced NETs are engulfed by DRG macrophages via GAS6-AXL, activating TLR7/9-NLRP3 and releasing IL-1β/IL-18, driving morphine tolerance.
Deleting Axl, Gas6 or Nlrp3, or blocking NETs, IL-1 or IL-18, alleviated tolerance.
